$comment: Every foreground/background pair components use (plan §15.4 CI rule 1), evaluated in both themes on the built tokens.css. Names are CSS variables without the prefix. Roles: text 4.5:1 (also 12 px text, decision 8c), large-text and non-text 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.3, 1.4.11), focus 3:1, decorative and disabled are reported only. Inverse surfaces (Toast, Tooltip) use the other theme's tokens, so the other theme's rows cover them.
